```{python}
import cmcrameri.cm as cmc
import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter

from rent_project.config import (
    DATA_DIRECTORY,
    OUTPUT_DIRECTORY,
    PROCESSED_DIRECTORY,
)
```

Loading data
```{python}
data = pd.read_parquet(PROCESSED_DIRECTORY / "greater_london_rents_dataset.parquet")
```

Checking data is ok

```{python}
# overall size
len(data) # 4 151 457

# number of dwellings
len(data[
    (data["is_residential_2011"] == True)
    & (data["state_2011"].eq("2") | data["state_2011"].isna())
]) # 3 450 307 dwellings in 2011

len(data[
    (data["is_residential_2021"] == True)
    & (data["state_2021"].eq("2") | data["state_2021"].isna())
]) # 3 795 583 dwellings in 2021

len(data[
    (data["is_residential_2026"] == True)
    & (data["state_2026"].eq("2") | data["state_2026"].isna())
]) # 3 956 394 dwellings in 2026

# number of private rented dwellings
len(data[data["private_rented_2011"] == True]) # 878 151 private rented in 2011
len(data[data["private_rented_2021"] == True]) # 1,174,022 private rented in 2021

# average estimated rent (not imputed)
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2011"].agg(["mean", "count"])
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2014"].agg(["mean", "count"])
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2021"].agg(["mean", "count"])
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2024"].agg(["mean", "count"])
```

Totals

```{python}
n_2011 = len(data[data["private_rented_2011"]]) # 878,151 private rented in 2011
t_2011 = data[data["private_rented_2011"]]["est_rent_2011"].sum() # £16,860,249,333 paid in 2011
t_2011 / n_2011 / 12 # average 1,600 pcm


n_2021 = len(data[data["private_rented_2021"]]) # 1,174,022 private rented in 2021
t_2021 = data[data["private_rented_2021"]]["est_rent_2021"].sum() # £28,271,600,199 paid in 2021
t_2021 / n_2021 / 12 # average 2,007 pcm

# If the same addresses were private rented in 2024, their residents would pay ...
data[data["private_rented_2021"]]["est_rent_2024"].sum() # £33,975,017,640 paid in 2024*

```

Maps

Data Prep

```{python}
points = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    data,
    geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(data["x_coordinate"], data["y_coordinate"]),
    crs="EPSG:27700",
)
boroughs = gpd.read_file(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "london-boroughs" / "london-boroughs-clipped.gpkg"
    ).to_crs("EPSG:27700")
london = boroughs.union_all()
hexagons = gpd.read_file(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "hex-grid-600m" / "hex-grid-600.shp"
    ).to_crs("EPSG:27700")

joined = gpd.sjoin(points, hexagons[["geometry"]], predicate="within")

# Rent only counts towards the total for privately rented properties
joined["rent_2011"] = joined["est_rent_2011"].where(joined["private_rented_2011"], 0)
joined["rent_2021"] = joined["est_rent_2021"].where(joined["private_rented_2021"], 0)

stats = joined.groupby("index_right").agg(
    n_properties=("uprn", "size"),
    n_private_rented_2011=("private_rented_2011", "sum"),
    n_private_rented_2021=("private_rented_2021", "sum"),
    t_rent_2011=("rent_2011", "sum"),
    t_rent_2021=("rent_2021", "sum"),
)
stats["t_rent_change"] = (stats["t_rent_2021"] / stats["t_rent_2011"] - 1) * 100
hexagons = hexagons.join(stats)  # hexagons with no properties get NaN
hexagons = hexagons.clip(london, keep_geom_type=True)

```

```{python}
# 350m: 329.3637446403049 properties per hexagon on average
# 600m: 864.3466583385384
hexagons['n_properties'].mean()

stats["t_rent_2011"].sum() # 16.9bn
plt.figure()
stats["t_rent_2011"].hist(bins=50)
plt.show()

stats["t_rent_2021"].sum() # 28.3bn
plt.figure()
stats["t_rent_2021"].hist(bins=50)
plt.show()

```

What maps do I want?
- Change in the number of private rented properties
- Change in average rent

2021 rent totals

```{python}
rent = hexagons["t_rent_2021"].dropna()
# vmax = rent.quantile(0.95)
vmax = 30000000
money = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"£{x / 1e6:g}m")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 9))

# map
hexagons.drop(rent.index).plot(ax=ax, color="#e6e6e6", linewidth=0, zorder=0)
hexagons.loc[rent.index].plot(
    column="t_rent_2021",
    cmap=cmc.batlow,
    vmin=0,
    vmax=vmax,
    legend=True,
    legend_kwds={
        "shrink": 0.6,
        "extend": "max",
        "format": money,
    },
    ax=ax,
)

# boroughs
boroughs.boundary.plot(
    ax=ax,
    color="white",
    linewidth=0.6,
    alpha=0.8,
    zorder=3,
)

ax.set_axis_off()
plt.tight_layout()
fig.canvas.draw()

# histogram
cbar_pos = fig.axes[1].get_position()
width = 0.12
height = cbar_pos.height * 0.3
gap = 0.02

hist_ax = fig.add_axes([cbar_pos.x0 - gap - width, cbar_pos.y0, width, height])
n, bins, patches = hist_ax.hist(rent.clip(upper=vmax), bins=15)

for patch in patches:
    patch.set_facecolor(cmc.batlow((patch.get_x() + patch.get_width() / 2) / vmax))

hist_ax.set_axis_off()

fig.savefig(OUTPUT_DIRECTORY / "total-rent-2021.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
plt.show()
```

2021 to 2021 total rent percentage change

```{python}

vmin = 30
vmax = 210

)

# histogram
```
